registration.fit_scope: Fixed float64 ridge and feature standardization use original30 frames only; no parameter selection.

representation: Current nominal cache visual512: last three real RGB-D frames through residual_visual; excludes robot fusion and persistent visual GRU.

coordinates.target: Current pre-action collision-geometry local-AABB center in palm-body xyz, meters
coordinates.label_role: Training target for diagnostic ridge only; never policy input

phases.student_after_contact: Student prefix from first valid observed >0.1 N fingertip contact onward, including later contact loss.
phases.legal_expert: Recorded expert_label_valid; actual expert authority and clean switch required. Transition/invalid rows excluded.
phases.before_contact: Before first valid observed contact; initial invalid contact excluded.
phases.after_contact: From first valid observed contact onward; observed forces may contact any body, not only the object.

aggregation: Frame-weighted vector RMSE and arithmetic mean of per-episode vector RMSE; empty phases reported with null errors.

provenance.source_hash_scope: Code used by this diagnostic, not a claim of cache-generation code identity.
provenance.payload_hash_scope: Full nominal shard/model/statistics/manifest hashes verified; raw HDF5 source SHA is manifest provenance, not rehashed here. Read labels, clocks and authority tensors hashed.

interpretation: Corrections were already used by these student models; only ridge fitting excludes them. These are actual-state distribution diagnostics, not held-out generalization or autonomous results. Prefix error can reflect inadequate original30 probe fit coverage, not lost geometric information in visual512. No proof of visual neglect, causal failure, or need to modify vision. Validation6 is reused for student selection/development. Different frame and episode means expose duration weighting.
